title: Scaling Preserves Hypercontractivity
statement: Let $(��)$ be a measure space, let $X$ be a real-valued function on it, and suppose $X$ is $(p,q,ho)$-hypercontractive. For every $c\in\bbr$, the function $cX$ is $(p,q,ho)$-hypercontractive.
replaced: Let $X$ be a real function on an arbitrary measure space, suppose $H_{p,q,\rho}(X)$, and let $c\in\bbr$. Then $H_{p,q,\rho}(cX)$. Write $H_{p,q,\rho}(X)$ for $1\le p\le q\le\infty$, $0\le\rho<1$, $X\in L^q(\mu)$, and $\|a+\rho bX\|_q\le\|a+bX\|_p$ for all $a,b\in\bbr$.
